content.text:
Publicly available, dated sources published between **July 8, 2026, and October 6, 2026**, show the following key developments for Apple Inc. (AAPL):

---

### 1. Financial Performance & Earnings Guidance
* **Q3 FY2026 Results (ended June 27, 2026):** On July 30–31, 2026, Apple reported June-quarter revenue of $109.4 billion (up 16% year-over-year) and diluted earnings per share of $2.02 (up 29% year-over-year). Both revenue and EPS set June-quarter records, assisted by double-digit growth in iPhone, Mac, and Services. Gross margin reached 50.1%, aided by a roughly 2 percentage-point favorable impact from tariff refunds. Apple declared a regular cash dividend of $0.27 per share.
* **Q4 FY2026 Guidance & Earnings Schedule:** Apple confirmed it will report its Q4 FY2026 financial results on November 2, 2026. Company guidance projected Q4 revenue growth of 9% to 11% year-over-year (approximately $111.7 billion to $113.7 billion), factoring in a ~2.5 percentage-point foreign exchange headwind. Gross margin for Q4 was guided to 47%–48%.

### 2. Executive Leadership & Governance Transition
* **CEO Succession:** Tim Cook announced that Q3 FY2026 would be his final earnings call as Chief Executive Officer. John Ternus has taken over as CEO and is slated to host his first quarterly earnings conference call for Q4 alongside CFO Kevan Parekh.

### 3. Product & Technological Developments
* **Foldable Hardware Entry:** On September 9, 2026, Apple introduced the **iPhone Duo**, marking its first foldable smartphone. The device features a 7.6-inch inner display, a 5.4-inch outer display, grade 5 titanium construction, an eSIM-only worldwide architecture, and the 2-nanometer A20 Pro chip. Pre-orders were slated for October 16, 2026, with general availability beginning October 23, 2026.
* **Software Platforms & Siri AI:** On September 14, 2026, Apple officially rolled out major operating system updates across iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS 27. The launch introduced the rollout of **Siri AI** (the next iteration of Apple Intelligence), integrating personal-context understanding and on-screen awareness.

### 4. Operational & Supply Chain Headwinds
* **Advanced Silicon Constraints:** Apple noted supply bottlenecks in advanced-node system-on-chip (SoC) production lines, driving supply constraints across iPhone, Mac, and iPad product lines going into the September quarter.
* **Component Inflation & Price Adjustments:** Sharp increases in memory/DRAM costs pressured hardware gross margins, prompting Apple to enact price increases across segments of its hardware portfolio in late June 2026.

### 5. Regulatory & Services Segment Signals
* **App Store Deceleration:** Sensor Tower data analyzed by UBS in early October 2026 indicated App Store revenue grew 5% year-over-year in September, contributing to approximately 2% growth for the September quarter (1% FX-neutral), down sequentially. Analysts pointed to potential regulatory interventions in Europe as an ongoing structural headwind for App Store monetization.
